finding: Heat-treatment type and cooling explain most of the development improvement; numeric heat temperature/duration alone do not.
robustness: The heat-category gain does not carry to source-publication-held-out development folds. It may encode source-specific associations; this is not proof of causation.
training_decision: No formula was promoted to the generator. No change to generic generation, model architecture, Optuna defaults, or final training.
scope: 452 Fe/Ni development rows only. Not a final TabICL comparison and not evidence that a trained informed model beats ratio 0.
nested_selection: Full candidate selection is weaker than the retrospectively best family. Paired intervals include zero; candidate selection is not robustly superior.
